import { mutation, query } from "./_generated/server";
import { v } from "convex/values";
import { getAuthUserId } from "@convex-dev/auth/server";

export const record = mutation({
  args: { userId: v.string(), planId: v.string(), feature: v.optional(v.string()), quantity: v.optional(v.number()) },
  returns: v.null(),
  handler: async (ctx, args) => { await ctx.db.insert("fixtureCheckoutDispatches", args); return null; },
});
export const evidence = query({
  args: {},
  returns: v.any(),
  handler: async (ctx) => {
    const userId = await getAuthUserId(ctx);
    if (!userId) throw new Error("Authentication required");
    const attempts = await ctx.db.query("billingAttempts").withIndex("by_userId_requestId", q => q.eq("userId", userId)).take(10);
    const calls = await ctx.db.query("fixtureCheckoutDispatches").withIndex("by_userId", q => q.eq("userId", userId)).take(10);
    return { userId, attempts, calls };
  },
});
